visualCharacteristics.purpose: Holiday shipping deadline panel with CSS calendars
visualCharacteristics.description: Green (#59a17b) title bar with white uppercase Roboto Condensed text; teal (#38a1be) body, radius 16px; stocking art left, deadline groups centre (consecutive rows with the same group share a heading, groups separated by dotted white rules), each date drawn as a CSS calendar (white card, red month, teal day panel, two rings) with an uppercase label below; truck art right with the note under it. Whole panel clickable via the title link. Mobile: groups wrap above the art.

contentPattern.structure: Title row (heading + link); art row (Left image | Right image); deadline rows (Group | Date e.g. Dec 16 | Label, optional); note row (single text cell). Rows are detected by content
contentPattern.description: Last day to order online for delivery before December 25: OCONUS APO/FPO Dec 8; CONUS Dec 16 Regular Ground, Dec 18 Priority; FedEx Dec 21 2 Day, Dec 23 Overnight; Some exclusions apply

usage.purpose: Editable shipping/order deadlines with calendar graphics.

reuseGuidance: Author dates as 'Mon D' (e.g. Dec 16) so they render as calendars. Repeat the group name on each row; consecutive equal groups merge.
